name: Isometry_Image_Packing
description: Frame the problem as finding isometries from domains [0, p] into [0, T]. The non-overlapping and precedence constraints are defined pointwise on the images of these isometries. Models will need to deduce that the continuous image of an isometry from [0, p] to R is a closed interval of length p, and that the pointwise inequalities constrain the sum of these lengths, removing all signal processing and interval-packing keywords.
